name: Road to Redemption
description: You've choked before. Everyone remembers. Now you have a chance to prove them wrong.

chapters.title: The Whispers
chapters.description: You hear them talking. 'He's gonna choke again.' 'Same old story.' A big battle is coming up - your chance to silence the doubters.

choices.label: Buckle Down
choices.description: Put in extra work. Leave nothing to chance.

choices.label: Embrace the Pressure
choices.description: Let them talk. Use their doubt as fuel.

choices.label: Block It Out
choices.description: Just focus on your craft. Ignore the noise.

chapters.title: The Grind
chapters.description: You've been working harder than ever. Late nights, early mornings. Your material is tight. But are you ready for the moment?

choices.label: Stay Hungry
choices.description: Keep grinding until the battle. No rest.

choices.label: Trust Your Work
choices.description: You've put in the time. Now trust yourself.

chapters.title: Fuel for the Fire
chapters.description: Every doubter, every hater - you're collecting receipts. The pressure is building, but so is your determination.

choices.label: It's Getting Heavy
choices.description: The weight of expectations is crushing.

chapters.title: Business as Usual
chapters.description: You've been treating this like any other battle. No extra pressure, no extra preparation. Just you.

choices.label: Last Minute Push
choices.description: Maybe you should put in some extra work after all...

chapters.title: The Moment
chapters.description: Battle day. The crowd knows your history. This is it - the moment you've been building toward.

choices.label: Prove Them Wrong
choices.description: Step up and deliver. Show them who you really are.

choices.label: Accept Whatever Happens
choices.description: Win or lose, choke or clutch - you're at peace with it.

endings.title: Redeemed
endings.description: You did it. When it mattered most, you stepped up. The 'Choker' label no longer defines you. You've proven that you can perform under pressure.

endings.title: Inner Peace
endings.description: You found something more valuable than proving doubters wrong - peace with yourself. Whatever happens in battles no longer controls your self-worth.

endings.title: Under Pressure
endings.description: The weight was too much. You tried to use the pressure as fuel, but it consumed you instead. The doubters had their ammunition reinforced.

endings.title: Nothing Changed
endings.description: You didn't make a big statement either way. The narrative about you remains unchanged. Maybe next time.
